Build a reviewer-aware validation or fresh-review queue.

Source: R/curation_sampling.R
curation_build_review_queue.Rd

Rows reviewed by another reviewer in the supplied project/corpus scope are returned first with mode = "validate". Once those are exhausted, a fresh country-stratified sample of never-reviewed rows is returned with mode = "fresh"; no available rows returns mode = "empty". The input review frame may use canonical reviewer_id or the legacy reviewer name.

Usage

curation_build_review_queue(
  records,
  reviews,
  reviewer_id = NULL,
  countries = NULL,
  n_per_country = 1L,
  seed = NULL,
  scope = NULL,
  reviewer = NULL
)

Arguments

records

A frame with country and document_id columns.

reviews

NULL or review rows. Rows with deleted = TRUE are ignored.

reviewer_id

Stable reviewer identity. reviewer is accepted as a legacy alias.

countries

Optional country filter.

n_per_country

Positive fresh-sample size per country.

seed

Optional integer seed. NA behaves like NULL; with an explicit seed, the caller's RNG state is restored.

scope

Optional curation scope used to filter explicit project/corpus columns in reviews.

reviewer

Legacy alias for reviewer_id.

Value

A tibble with document_id and country columns and a mode attribute.
